# v2.51-dev Release Notes

## Fixed the remaining dark band at the bottom of the mobile menu

The previous release stopped the mobile navigation menu from leaving a dark
tint at the **top** of the screen after closing, but a similar band could still
linger at the **bottom**, behind the browser's address bar. This release clears
that too.

### Fixed

- **No more dark band at the bottom after closing the mobile menu.** The menu's
  dimming overlay is now sized to the visible screen area instead of extending
  behind the mobile browser's toolbars, so there's no hidden strip left to stay
  darkened. Closing the menu — by the ✕, tapping outside, or following a link —
  now leaves the whole page clean, top and bottom.

### Notes

- Visual fix only. No database migration and no configuration required. Opening,
  closing, and tapping outside the menu all work exactly as before.
